text: The new skill folder contains every required file.
SKILL.md has frontmatter name, description, semver version and all required sections.
The frontmatter name equals the folder name.
SKILL.md stays within 150 lines and the cover within 40 KB.
Every rule maps to a check or a checklist item.
Every check id used by a rule is named in a test file.
Links never leave the skill folder; docs paths are written in backticks.
preview.json has title, a tagline of at most 90 characters, prompt, outputs and at most 5 tags.
cover.svg is safe: viewBox, no script, no foreignObject, no external href, token colours only.
No invented facts: unknown goals or constraints are asked, not assumed.
checklist: Reviewer confirms the intent and rules come from the interview, not guesses.
